versions.changelog:
Major update: The skill is now focused on Product Hunt launch strategy and planning, instead of real-time launch stats.

- Transforms the skill into a Product Hunt launch strategist assistant.
- Guides users to build a comprehensive launch plan via structured discovery questions.
- Provides tailored pre-launch, launch week, launch day, and post-launch action steps.
- Includes a step-by-step weekly checklist and curated further reading.
- Real-time stat tracking features have been removed.
